verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a bare documentation page titled "Webhooks" (hatchet-docs-30). It has no content showing whether these are registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a consumer can subscribe to, or something else such as inbound triggers. The axis applies to a workflow orchestration platform, but the pack does not document event subscription via outbound webhooks, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
